brief:
An American report indicated that the THAAD air defense system deployed in Israel has completed operational integration with additional systems, the Maan Wire reported. The integration represents a significant advancement in Israel's air defense capabilities.

American teams stationed in the region are on the highest state of alert, according to the report. The development comes amid ongoing regional tensions and escalating military capabilities in the area.
title: US report: Israel's THAAD system achieves full operational integration
